text:
emma: Quick sync — weekend push for the Apr 12 webinar. We need a small retarget + search pivot to hit ~1.2k signups. Can we confirm plan?

leo: rough numbers — last week we did 480 signups with $28 CPL. To get to 1.2k we need +2.5x volume or shave CPL to ~$11. Neither realistic in 72h, so prioritize quality traffic for webinar.

jamal: Agree. Proposed approach: 1) scale high-intent search (branded + intent short tail), 2) small retargeting cadence refresh with new hero creative, 3) tight pacing windows to frontload budget before webinar.

olivia: For creative — I have a short hero_v2 that increased CTR by 18% on a small test. Want to push that to retarget audiences and lookalikes.

emma: Good. What about budget pacing? I don't want us to burn through daily cap and then go silent on the final day.

leo: Let's use time-of-day pacing: 60% of daily budget during 9am-6pm local, 40% evening burst 6pm-11pm. Also set hourly cap alerts.

ad-bot: Campaign snapshot (automated): CTR 3.1% | Avg CPC $2.10 | CPL $34 | Conv rate 2.5% — dashboard: https://ads.company/dashboards/webinar-weekend

maria: Retarget lists: 7d engaged, 14d site visitors (product pages), and last webinar registrants (exclude). Cadence: 0, 1, 3, 7 days. Sequence copy variations: short CTA / social proof / feature snippet.

patrick: Recommend A/B for hero_v2 vs hero_v2b (shorter headline). Keep 20% traffic to control. Also run a 1-day aggressive bid on branded short tail keywords to capture late-intent signups.

alex: UTMs for webinar: utm_source=paid&utm_medium=search|social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr12_v2&utm_content={creative}. Make sure inbound lead routing tags webinars so SDRs can prioritize.

jamal: On bids: decrease max CPC by 15% for broad retargeting audiences (to control spend) and increase max CPC by 10-20% on branded + intent keywords. We should watch impressions share drop.

olivia: Creative rollout plan: swap hero_v2 at 50% retarget traffic now, hold remaining 50% for hero_v2b until we have 4 hours of stats. If v2 wins, scale to 100% by tonight.

emma: Sounds good. Can someone drop the exact campaign update snippet so I can paste in Ads Manager?

jamal: Sure — quick json for bulk upload: ```
[
  {"campaign_id": "89234", "update": {"max_cpc": "-15%", "target_audience": "retarget_7d"}},
  {"campaign_id": "89300", "update": {"max_cpc": "+15%", "keywords": ["redwood inference webinar","llm inference platform webinar"]}},
  {"campaign_id": "89421", "update": {"creative_swap": "hero_v2", "traffic_split": "50/50"}}
]
```

emma: Perfect. I'll run the bulk changes at 10:00pm PST and enable hourly pacing alerts. @leo can you monitor spend and pause if CPL > $65 for >2 hours? :eyes:  

leo: Yup — I'll watch and will pause campaigns if the threshold hits. :thumbsup:

maria: Also routing note — make sure form posts include lead_source=paid_webinar and route to SDR queue "Webinar-APR12". I updated the zapier mapping: https://zapier.com/app/editor/flows/abcd1234

patrick: One more ask — add a small retarget creative with testimonial quote for the 24h pre-event push. Typically lifts conversion by ~12%.

olivia: I have a ready asset, uploading to drive now: https://drive.company/marketing/hero_v2_testimonial.png

emma: Thanks all. Summary: jamal runs bid/creative swaps at 10pm PST, leo monitors alerts, maria ensures lead routing, olivia uploads creative, patrick runs A/B and testimonial for pre-event push. Check back in at 11:15pm to confirm scale.

ad-bot: Update scheduled: bulk upload queued at 2024-04-11T22:00:00Z — job id job_88421

leo: noted — will report at 11:15.

emma: Closing thread — final notes in the docs channel after results. Good work team. :rocket:
